title: Chapter 478 Wang Shuo'S Ambition
content:
Chapter 478 Wang Shuo'S Ambition

Feng Ming was left alone, slumped in a chair.

He was upset. Although he had expected this, he didn't expect Wang Shuo to actually choose this.

That afternoon, Feng Ming left with his men.

In the palace, Wang Shuo stood in a very large room, with a very large sand table in front of him.

All the major empires of the Shenwu Empire have been marked.

This is what Wang Shuo will do next.

Include all the territories in the territory of the Vana Empire.

The three current first-level empires are the Mininia Empire, the Batandia Empire, and the Maka Empire.

The more famous second-level empires are Andre's Parthian Empire and Queen Anna's Truni Empire.

These are stumbling blocks for Wang Shuo to unify the Shenwu Empire.

But it is obvious that now is not a good time to take action against them.

The strength must be developed to the point where even if they unite, they will be unable to resist.

But recently, the number of people in the Vana Empire who have broken through to the strongest king has been decreasing.

Except for the first wave of people, who have a very high probability of breaking through, only one in ten or twelve of the people selected later can break through.

Wang Shuo felt that it should be a new area, and those powerful people seemed to have great luck.

Otherwise, how to explain that more than 10 strongest kings were born in Dahuai Domain at once.

So, Wang Shuo cast his eyes on the newly created novice area.

This novice area is called Mo Nan Domain.

Obviously, they have bad luck and are located on the border of the Wana Empire.

The Wana Empire did not give them any chance at all and conquered it directly.

Wang Shuo ordered to start selecting potential generals in Mo Nan Domain, and then enter the ancient battlefield and the three-star secret realm.

After becoming a high-level general, enter the tomb of the king.

After three years of continuous training, the empire finally added 5 strongest kings.

Three of them are from the new area, and two are trained in Dahuai Domain.

At the same time, the number of generals has reached thousands.

Wang Shuo decided that he could not wait any longer.

Wang Shuo intends to launch a war against several other empires.

In the Shenwu Empire, a war that will sweep across hundreds of empires is about to begin.

Just as Wang Shuo convened a court meeting to discuss the war.

Several other first-level empires were also doing the same thing.

They all felt that they could not wait any longer.

In the Shenwu Empire, envoys from various countries kept traveling between various empires.

Everyone was trying their best to win over allies, or adopt the strategy of uniting the many, or adopting the strategy of forming alliances.

It was really a storm brewing.

The climate became weird.

There were either droughts or floods in various parts of the Shenwu Empire.

The Wana Empire was also facing various natural disasters.

It seemed that they wanted to prevent the countries from fighting each other.

But Wang Shuo knew that Lord Zak definitely did not think so. He just wanted to make this war more exciting.

In Wana City, during this period, envoys from various countries have never stopped.

Some small countries wanted to become vassal states and surrendered voluntarily.

There are also vassal states of other great powers that secretly surrendered.

There are also other great powers that sent people to form an alliance.

Wang Shuo attaches the most importance to the first-level empire in the north, the Maka Empire.

On the sand table, the Maka Empire and the Vana Empire are located in the north and south of the Shenwu Empire.

The other two first-level empires are located in the east and west.

These four empires are currently the four most powerful empires in the Shenwu Empire.

If Wang Shuo wants to expand his territory, he must take action against the Mininia Empire and the Batandia Empire, which are located in the east and west.
